name: open_app
description: Open an installed app or program on the computer by its name or what it is: Spotify, WhatsApp, Chrome, VS Code, Notepad, Excel, the browser, the terminal, File Explorer. Understands loose names and abbreviations and asks when more than one app could be meant.

app.description: the app as the user said it, e.g. 'spotify', 'vs code', 'the browser'; never a file or a website

exact.description: internal follow-up only, never set it

not_for: opening a file or a folder
switching to a window that is already open
